# ARK II

> ARK II is an independent digital studio created by Linuka Bandara, focused on premium websites, web applications, redesigns and digital experiences.

## Website

- https://ark-ii.studio/

## About

ARK II is a Sri Lanka-based digital studio serving ambitious businesses in Sri Lanka and worldwide. The studio combines web development, responsive interface design, interaction design, motion and visual storytelling to create polished digital experiences.

## Creator

- Linuka Bandara: https://linukabandara.me/
- GitHub: https://github.com/linuka7

## Source

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/LinukaBandara/ark-ii

## Services / capabilities

- Web design
- Frontend web development
- Responsive and mobile-first interfaces
- UI/UX design
- Website redesigns
- Web applications
- Interaction and motion design
- Digital product presentation

## Technology

ARK II is built with React and Vite, with JavaScript/JSX, CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis and Lucide React.

## Identity

ARK II is a client-facing digital studio and portfolio project created and maintained by Linuka Bandara.
